title: 宝塚記念の後に・鼓動と輝き

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka emerges victorious from the race. Disappointed by her loss, Air Groove challenges Silence Suzuka to another race in the future, where she vows to restore her pride.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka recognizes the passionate drive within Air Groove, and the two shake hands to seal the new challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Witnessing Silence Suzuka's performance in the Takarazuka Kinen inspires both El Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder to step up their game as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As summer camp approaches, Silence Suzuka prepares herself for an all-new challenge.
